name: agentic/faq-accordion
title: FAQ Accordion
description: Expandable question/answer list. Uses native <details> — no JavaScript. Set introHeading/introText/imageUrl for a 3-column layout with an intro blurb and image beside the accordion.

default.question: How long does shipping take?
default.answer: Orders ship within one business day and typically arrive in 3–5 days.

default.question: What is your return policy?
default.answer: Return anything unused within 30 days for a full refund.

default.question: Do you ship internationally?
default.answer: Yes — rates are calculated at checkout.
